about.heroSubtitle: We're a family business specialized in kids entertainment and party organization in El Salvador and Miami.
about.historyP1: Kidsfun was born from the dream of turning every kids celebration into a magical and unforgettable experience. We started as a small family business and today we're a reference for bounce house rentals, electric games and party organization in El Salvador.
about.historyP2: Over time, we expanded to Miami to bring the magic of Kidsfun to more families, always keeping the values that defined us from day one: safety, quality and close service.
about.missionBody: Make every kids party safe, fun and stress-free for parents, offering quality products and a personalized service that exceeds their expectations.
about.visionBody: Be the leading kids entertainment company in the region, known for our innovation, quality and commitment to child safety.

terms.intro: Please read carefully the terms governing the use of our website and services.
terms.lastUpdated: Please read the terms carefully before using our service.

s1.title: Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing and using this website, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions of use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, we recommend that you do not use our site.

s2.title: Service Description
s2.body: Kidsfun y Fiestas Infantiles is a company dedicated to kids entertainment, specialized in:
list: Bounce house, jumper and slide rentals

s3.title: Use of the Website
s3.body: You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes. It is prohibited to:
list: Use the site for any illegal or unauthorized purpose
Transmit viruses, malware or harmful code
Interfere with the operation of the site
Attempt to access restricted areas of the site

s4.title: Bookings and Payments
s4.body: To confirm a booking of our services:
list: A 50% deposit is required to confirm the date
The remaining payment must be made before or on the day of the event
Full payment in advance includes a 5% discount
Payments are made via Zelle or bank transfer

s5.title: Cancellations and Refunds
list: Cancellation with more than 7 days notice: 80% refund
Cancellation with less than 3 days: no refund
Rescheduling at no cost subject to availability

s6.title: Safety and Waiver
s6.body: To participate in activities, you must sign the waiver document. Participants must follow our staff's instructions at all times. Kidsfun is not responsible for injuries caused by misuse of equipment or failure to follow safety rules.

s7.title: Privacy and Personal Data
s7.body: Your privacy is important to us. We collect, use and protect your personal information according to industry-standard practices. We do not share your data with third parties without your express consent, unless required by law.

s8.title: Intellectual Property
s8.body: All content on this website (texts, images, logos, designs) is the property of Kidsfun y Fiestas Infantiles and is protected by intellectual property laws. Total or partial reproduction is prohibited without prior authorization.

s9.title: Limitation of Liability
s9.body: Kidsfun will not be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use our services. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid for the contracted service.

s10.title: Modifications
s10.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Modifications will be effective immediately after publication on the website. Continued use of the site after any change constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
